_doc: Stock enrichi de decks 'Cliché Maximum' par métier (brand Pocket Decks). Chargé automatiquement par scripts/produce_card_game.py via _load_external_decks(). Override les decks en dur si même clé. Objectif jouabilité commerciale TGC : 30+ questions / 60+ réponses par deck.
_mechanic: cliche_maximum (questions à trous + cartes-réponses, style Blanc Manger Coco)

devops.name: DevOps Disasters: The Card Game
devops.tagline: 16+. For people who deploy on Friday and pray. The party game for SREs, sysadmins and anyone who has cried in a terminal.
devops.bg_prompt: subtle dark server room data center blinking lights terminal green glow decorative pattern background, ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT NO LETTERS
